snippet.title: Boiled Bison Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Boiled Bison is a psychological horror that pays homage to 1970’s slasher films and classic 6th gen horror games alike. Looking for the next big story to report on after losing his job as a news anchor, jaded journalist Frankie Loza finds himself driving down a lonely road in the middle of Rural New Mexico, where he comes across a lonely shack on the side of the road advertising "Yummy Buffalo Jerky". Desperate to find anything to get his job back, Frankie goes to investigate this ominous shack, only to be pulled into a gruesome mystery when he wakes up in an abandoned bison meat processing plant… 

Playing as Frankie, it's up to you to find a way to escape, and to uncover the secrets behind The Sterlington Meat Company once and for all.

Wishlist it now on Steam and catch the demo on October 19th for Next Fest! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5058110/Boiled_Bison/
